title: alchemilla coriacea var. demissa
intro: Alchemilla coriacea var. demissa, commonly known as alpine lady's mantle, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, calm digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of alpine lady's mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
